review_focus:
Item P58.2 (#616), phase 5. The ADDENDUM-06 entry is the spec:
### P58.2 Annotation writes and pending until ack

- Branch: `epic/p58b-annotation-writes`. Lanes: S, D, U, P. Model: `opus`. Depends on: P57 (it reuses P57's content-side view comparison), P58.1 and P55.3 (both edit `optimisticLocal.ts`).
- **Goal:** the 27 annotation write commands go through `er_send` and the thread paints shrink to pending until ack.
- **Done when:** each write carries the `TabKey` and the view the page painted (today's `OptimisticView`, `snapshot.rs:165`, with the tab index replaced by the key: repo root, PR number, branch view and mode) and maps, by that key and with no App lock, to a service command (the 12 thread, comment and promote writes to the commands P41 added, the nine finding, checklist, artifact and diagram writes to the commands this entry adds, below; the six UI annotation writes stay desktop writes to `ui_annotations(tab)`): a key the registry does not list answers `NotFound` (A2), and a painted view that differs from the content's is refused, as `route_annotation` (`commands.rs:6873`) refuses it today through `abort_wrong_view` on the App (`:6883`), the check that also guards the follower lag; this replaces the App-side check for the 11 commands of `route_annotation`'s 14 that this entry ports (P57 ports `bulk_review_pillar` and `unbulk_review_pillar`, P59 `reply_to_github_thread`, all under the same rule) and for the finding, checklist and UI annotation edits that still run `abort_wrong_view` on the App; the view comparison is the content-side helper P57 adds; the nine writes with no service command today, which lock the App, write to `app.tab().er_dir()` and call `reload_ai_state` (`dismiss_finding` `commands.rs:10209`, `resolve_finding` `:10250`, `unresolve_finding` `:10269`, `remove_finding_thread` `:3104`, `update_finding_response` `:6231`, `delete_finding_response` `:6254`, `toggle_checklist_item` `:10186`, `delete_review_artifact` `:10154`, `delete_diagram` `:4529`), get eight er-service commands (lane S), so the actor stays the AI section's one writer (A3): `DismissFinding`, `SetFindingResolved` (resolve and unresolve), `RemoveFindingThread`, `UpdateFindingResponse`, `DeleteFindingResponse`, `ToggleChecklistItem`, `DeleteReviewArtifact` and `DeleteDiagram`; each effect calls on `context.er_dir` (and `context.comments_dir` for the linked GitHub threads) the always-compiled helper the old body calls, in `er_engine::ai`'s `finding_cleanup.rs`, `finding_responses.rs`, `promotions.rs` and `diagrams.rs`, and for the checklist `checklist_store::set_checked` with the item id the AI section holds at the index, as `App::toggle_checklist_item_at` does (`crates/er-engine/src/app/state/comments.rs:1982`); `cleanup_triage` and `cleanup_review_artifacts` (`crates/er-engine/src/app/state/mod.rs:8527`, `:8538`, `ui`-gated) move to the always-compiled half and stay re-exported from `er_engine::app`; each effect re-reads its readers' AI state through `with_reloaded_ai` (`er-service/src/sidecar_reload.rs:128`) and stamps it under P58.1's own-write rule; `DeleteReviewArtifact` runs the admission check on `context.er_dir` through `er_engine::arena::check_bucket_admission`, which is all `App::check_review_bucket_admission` (`review_flow_admission.rs:13`, called at `commands.rs:10165`) does; `delete_review_artifact` and `delete_diagram` check no view today and call no `abort_wrong_view`; with the flag on they carry the key and the painted view and are refused under the same rule, because each deletes from the view's bucket, and their flag-off bodies stay as they are; the UI annotation writes and `save_annotation_screenshot` write `ui-annotations.json` and the screenshots in `context.er_dir`, the directory `TabState::comments_dir()` returns today (`crates/er-engine/src/app/state/mod.rs:2168`–`:2170`; `commands.rs:11693`, `:11815`, `:11873`, `:11889`, `:11908`, `:11950`), never `context.comments_dir`, the GitHub-comment bucket (`er-service/src/protocol.rs:487`–`:488`); `add_document_thread` (today `service_add_document_thread`, `commands.rs:2843`, reading the App tab's preview at `:2861`–`:2870` and `:2875`–`:2883`) compares the request's preview key with the content's preview key for its `TabKey`, as P56.2 does for `request_file_preview`, and refuses a changed document; the three lag tests in `commands/tests/tab_key_tests.rs` (`a_paint_is_refused_while_the_app_lags_the_registry` `:402`, `route_annotation_refuses_a_write_while_the_app_lags_the_registry` `:443`, `a_document_thread_is_refused_while_the_app_lags_the_registry` `:527`) get keyed successors here and keep running until P62.2 deletes them with `commands/`; `reply_to_finding` maps `ai_assist = false` only, and its `ai_assist` arm is P60.2's; the flag-on `delete_thread` and `remove_finding_thread` mappings call P58.1's owner removal for the thread's or finding's pending ask-AI reply (the old bodies remove it at `commands.rs:3065` and `:3125`), which bumps `jobs`; the 17 remaining `OptimisticOp` kinds are classified by name (A8). Pending until ack, with the `client_id`, the confirming fetch landing on the same row (ADR 0017): `add-thread`, `reply`, `promote`, `promote-finding` and `reply-finding` (its `existing` and `new` targets; the `ai` target paints nothing). Deleted with the flag on, the `annotations(tab)` or `ui_annotations(tab)` push painting the result: `resolve`, `delete-root`, `delete-reply`, `edit`, `dismiss-finding`, `resolve-finding`, `add-annotation`, `delete-annotation`, `checklist-toggle`, `remove-finding-thread`, `delete-finding-response` and `edit-finding-response`. Thread ordering, the one rule these paints applied, moved to the server in P58.1. The add-question median is recorded against the A9 baseline, and the deleted paints are timed click-to-paint with `profileLog`, numbers in the PR.
- **Planted breaks:** dropping `client_id` makes the confirmed row get a fresh id and fails the confirm test; a `resolve` still painted with the flag on fails the flag test; a `reply-finding` with a `new` target that does not paint pending fails the pending test; a write resolved to the registry's active tab instead of its own key lands on the other tab and fails the keyed-write test (the successor of `:402`); a write for a key the registry no longer lists that is not refused fails the unknown-key test (the successor of `:443`); dropping the view comparison lets a write painted in another mode land and fails the stale-view test; a document thread checked against the App tab's preview, or not checked, fails the document test (the successor of `:527`), and with the App locked a flag-on document thread still answers; a delete that skips the pending-reply removal leaves the "…thinking" entry in `jobs` and fails the delete test; with the App locked, each of the nine finding, checklist, artifact and diagram writes answers and moves the `annotations(tab)` version, one case per command, and routing any one through its App body times out and fails its case; a `DeleteReviewArtifact` on a bucket whose workflow lease is held is refused, and skipping the admission check deletes the review and fails; a `delete_review_artifact` or `delete_diagram` painted in another mode of the same tab is refused, and dropping the view comparison deletes from the other view's bucket and fails; on a local PR tab in Branch view, whose comments directory (the PR bucket) differs from its `er_dir`, a UI annotation write and a screenshot land in `er_dir` (the test first asserts that the two differ), and writing to `context.comments_dir` fails.
- **Fallback split (the plan):** P58.2a threads, comments and promote (the 12 writes on P41's commands); P58.2b the eight service commands and the nine finding, checklist, artifact and diagram writes (lane S); P58.2c the UI annotation writes.
- Size: L.

Check: every done-when item exists and each planted break fails; flag-off unchanged; new commands satisfy er::command_shape and its allow-list only shrinks; source scans hold; History, Conflicts and Hidden keep the snapshot fallback until P56.3; each PR under 1,500.
